purpose: Agentic memory bank for TSPS audit — single source of truth for what is broken, what needs investigation, and what is verified clean.

deduplication_report.method: Normalized line hashing + AUD-ID extraction + exact title matching across all Memory files

intentional_duplication.note: 03_Found_Bugs_and_Issues.md and FULL_AUDIT_REPORT.md contain the same 40 finding blocks by design. 03 is the authoritative modular register; FULL is a frozen legacy snapshot retained for provenance. Agents MUST read 03 (or this registry), not FULL, for findings.
intentional_duplication.action: Documented as intentional, not removed. FULL is read-only.

incidental_content_overlap.note: 00_INDEX.md and 04_AuDHD_Friendly_Summary.md summarize candidates/findings for navigation. This is intentional summary layering, not finding duplication. No separate deduplication needed beyond ensuring summaries reference this registry.
overlapping_item_id_mentions: 1047 (Cave horror, 2 pending entries — distinct aspects: accuracy vs venom)
113 (Strength potion, 2 pending contexts — alchemy vs Herblore)

deduplication_report.conclusion: No true duplicate finding/candidate entries requiring deletion. All cross-file overlap is intentional layering (findings register + pending + summaries) or legacy provenance retention.
deduplication_report.note: Reorg v1.2: findings/pending/completed split into domain folders; registry now carries file+domain per entry.

read_order: 00_INDEX.md for human status overview + document tree
registry.json (this file) for machine-readable task list (file + domain per entry)
findings/<domain>.md for full finding evidence before fixing
completed/<domain>.md to avoid re-auditing verified clean areas
rules: Search registry.json (all three arrays) case-insensitively by id/title/slug before filing.
One root per entry — do not duplicate AUD/CAND/CHK.
Triple-verify active runtime + exact READ-ONLY-DB key + Wiki via DB wiki_url/*-wiki-page-text only (no web_search).
Only main agent may edit Memory/; never edit Typescript-RSPS/ or READ-ONLY-DB/.
GOAL_RESUME.md and HANDOFF.md are gitignored — local resume state only, not published.
New findings go to findings/<domain>.md + registry; candidates to pending/<domain>/<sub>.md + registry.
how_to_pick_work: Bugs to fix: findings[] where status=Open, ordered by severity High > Medium > Low
Areas needing investigation: pending[] — each is a scoped candidate with location and DB reference to chase
Areas to skip: completed[] — already bounded-checked with no mismatch

findings.title: Elemental weaknesses are not ingested into server NPC combat definitions
findings.category: 2. Monsters / NPCs / Combat Stats (also 9. Combat Formulas)

TSPS runtime `server/data/definitions/monsters-complete.json` contains matching field values for both sample IDs.

findings.title: Ranged defence is collapsed to the standard category

findings.title: Declared native NPC option-5 opcode 50 has no decoder case
findings.category: 13. Client ↔ Server Protocol / Packets
findings.db_reference: Not data-comparable; native packet semantics have no corresponding DB records.
findings.description: Both client/server native packet tables declare OPNPC5 as opcode 50 with length 3, but server ClientProtocol maps opcode 57 to option 5 and has no case 50. The current browser client uses opcode 57 for its option-5 action, masking the unused declaration for in-repo traffic.

findings.title: Offensive combat spells omit per-cast base Magic experience
findings.category: 11. Skills & Experience (also 9. Combat Formulas)
findings.db_reference: The inspected READ-ONLY-DB schema/data has no combat spell XP rule; comparator: [OSRS Wiki Combat spells](https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Combat_spells), Offensive spells. TSPS spell record `CombatSpells.WIND_STRIKE` defines `baseExperience()` as 5 at lines 320-338; Wiki currently lists Wind Strike at 5.5 XP.
findings.description: Combat XP dispatch awards damage-based Magic XP for accurate offensive spells but does not award the spell-specific base XP. Splashes receive a fixed 52 Magic XP rather than the selected spell's base award.

findings.title: Combat XP flooring discards OSRS fractional tenths
findings.category: 11. Skills & Experience (also 9. Combat Formulas)
findings.db_reference: No combat XP formula or fractional XP representation was found in the inspected READ-ONLY-DB schemas/data. Comparator: [OSRS Wiki Experience](https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Experience) and [Combat spells](https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Combat_spells) document tenths-based fixed-point XP and per-damage rules.
findings.description: Combat reward formulas floor XP to whole numbers, and SkillManager sanitization also floors existing/current XP values to integers. This discards fractional combat rewards and prevents their accumulation to the next visible whole XP.
